UI art direction: before and after

Mockup for the OpenSpec change ui-art-direction. The owner, on itch.io: "cleanup the ui so it looks like a proper game, and not like the vibe coded look you AIs make", "I also dont like the controls text in the bottom, makes it look messy", "input controls can be in the options menu", "as a square panel", "think shipped product", "buttons and text need to scale with reference pixels at 1920x1080". The consoles keep their approved look (consoles.html); this is everything around them.
